Train the diffusion network with a masked denoising score-matching loss

Source: R/imputeLongitudinal.R
train_diffusion.Rd

Internal helper for imputeLongitudinal's method = "diffusion" backend. At every epoch, each row is noised to an independently-sampled random timestep, the network predicts the noise that was added, and the squared-error loss is averaged only over observed entries (X_mask == 1) – missing entries have no real x0 to noise in the first place, so scoring them would just train the network to fit whatever placeholder (zero) value they were filled with. This mirrors train_miwae's observed-entries-only reconstruction term, and matches the masked training objective used by MissDiff (Ouyang et al., 2023) for diffusion models on incomplete tabular data.

Usage

train_diffusion(
  net,
  X_cov,
  X_resp,
  X_mask,
  epochs,
  diffusion_steps,
  time_emb_dim,
  learning_rate = 0.001
)
